content: I'm confused by #4844. It looks like there was a review claimed in this comment, but now it's in the merge queue (even though still marked as awaiting review). What are the criteria for getting into the merge queue?
This is the same as the issues I described in #Tau Ceti > review/merge race .

Before fixes for the workers land, we can notice such events and make a refactor PR to fix the redisual issues.

This is one of the reasons why I don't blindly point workers to math I care, I have agents routinely review the quality of my own PRs (or other PRs in the roadmaps I concern), and identify issues and potential refactors.

I made some changes. Hopefully between

  • TauCetiReview PR #125 (https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiReview/pull/125)
  • TauCeti PR #5004 (https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/pull/5004)

we'll see less of this.
